page.overview:
Who is Albert?

Albert was a wizard and student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, who was sorted into Hufflepuff in the 1990s. He said that Argus Filch talked to his cat suggesting that he was a character in the plot to open the Chamber of Secrets, and that Filch punished him for being out of bed at night time. He said that he wished there would be an Heir of Hufflepuff and asked Harry Potter if he could say Albert in Parseltongue. He once got a bag of beetle pincers by owl.
